### seperate columns
```{r}
nlp_table <- tbl(con, "visits_nlp_tier1")
our.features <- nlp_table %>% select(visit_id, starts_with("nlp_mean_coherence")) %>% select(visit_id, contains("Tpi")) %>%  
  select(visit_id, contains(c("nlp_mean_coherence_sentence_GloVe", "nlp_mean_coherence_sentence_USE", "sentence_BERT_", "sentence_ELMo" ))) %>% 
  pivot_longer(starts_with("nlp_mean"), names_to="feature_name", values_to="feature_value") %>% 
  collect() %>% 
  separate_wider_regex(feature_name, c("nlp_", feat=".+", "_", "crampingtexs"=".+")) %>% # split out the crampingtexs part of the feature column name 
  unpack_crampingtexs(crampingtexs)
```
